reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthActionCategories/isSkippedByMonthAction used by the other month-wide actions and reads spending via getSheetValue, but writes its own sign conversion.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-action 'income only in tracking budgets' check that each sibling already copies, and re-expresses the expense sign flip the average actions do with avg *= -1.

placement.why: The action sits in server/budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Follows the tree's existing pattern closely so it is easy to own, though the income rule and sign rule remain per-action copies that a future change must touch here too.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getMonthActionCategories and isSkippedByMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: The expense sign flip is rewritten as 'cat.is_income === 1 ? netAmount : 0 - netAmount' instead of the siblings' 'if (is_income === 0) avg *= -1'; the income/tracking check is a plain copy.
